text:
leo.q: Hey all, first day! I clicked the Okta invite but it says 'email not in directory'. I think Gmail auto-aliased my address (leo.q+work@gmail.com). Can someone resend to leo.q@redwood.com?

olivia-peopleops: Welcome Leo :wave: Sending now to leo.q@redwood.com and revoking the other invite. Check spam and promotions, invites expire in 24h.

1password-bot: 1Password: pending invite will be sent after Okta activation.

leo.q: Got the new invite, accepted, then hit MFA. The browser offered my personal iCloud passkey and when I tried to use it Okta failed with 'authenticator mismatch'. Would rather not tie personal passkeys.

sam-it: Hey Leo 1 Quick fix: use an incognito window to avoid autofill of personal passkeys. If you prefer no passkeys, choose "Set up a different authenticator" -> "Authenticator app" and scan the QR with 1Password.

leo.q: Incognito worked to get to the MFA step but when I tried to register a new passkey it errored with 'attestation policy: unsupported'. I'm on macOS Big Sur with Chrome 109.

mfa-helper: Attestation errors on older OS/browser combos are common. Options: 1) Register a TOTP in 1Password and finish onboarding, then register a company-bound passkey from a newer machine later. 2) Use a security key (YubiKey) if available.

sam-it: Also try Safari if you can; macOS platform authenticators are generally better there. I'll watch the admin console and can force a session re-sync if Okta doesn't reflect the registration.

leo.q: Switched to Safari and registered a passkey successfully, but Okta still shows MFA incomplete.

sam-it: That means our IdP didn't persist the attestation. I'm forcing a re-sync now and clearing any stale registration tokens for your session. Try reloading the enrollment page after a minute.

leo.q: Reloaded and it shows ACTIVE now. 1Password invite arrived a few minutes later. Thanks!

olivia-peopleops: Great — welcome aboard! If anyone else hits alias/autofill issues, ping #new-hires or me and we can resend or toggle per-user policy. :tada:
